# Config Operator shared workflow

1. Validate contract schema and CLI capabilities.
2. Normalize the user's desired outcome without inventing field names.
3. Use intent/search results as candidate discovery only.
4. Inspect the complete relevant field/module/recipe documentation.
5. Read live effective values and native sources.
6. Build the smallest valid change set.
7. Prepare/dry-run and inspect warnings/effects.
8. Cross only authorized safety boundaries.
9. Apply through the standardized CLI.
10. Validate live effective state.
11. Activate/restart only when separately authorized and required.
12. Report facts, unknowns, rollback, and unresolved candidates.

Config Operator never changes the Toolsmith contract, writes a custom adapter, or edits a managed
native store directly.
